name: @test-cabinet/simple-2d
description: The Simple 2D engine: the runtime a produced 2D game is built on. An engine is created over a canvas and bound to one game, and it owns the frame loop and its replaceable clock, the letterboxed device-pixel-ratio-aware canvas fit, named input actions over keyboard bindings and touch layouts, an audio cue bus with its first-gesture unlock, asset resolution under a fixed root, and a diagnostics overlay — leaving the game to write only its own simulation and rendering. Everything it does is observed by subscribing to its events rather than by reading a log it accumulates, and it publishes a read-mostly host interface on `window` so a post-run check can confirm that a build booted and is running frames.
